senses.gloss:
Umbe(ve)ka
mīmāṁsaka. C. 660-725. His identity is obscure; some have argued his identity with poet Bhavabhūti, a. also with Maṇḍana-Viśvarūpa-Sureśvara; may or may not be identical with Bhavabhūti but certainly not with Maṇḍana etc. See for review of the whole discussion, Intro. to the edn. of his C. on Ślokavārttika, Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 13. See also AIOC. XIX. Summary of Papers, p.. 34-36; IHQ. XXXIV. p.. 28-39; J. of the U. P. His.. Res. Soc. XVII. p. 32; [Page397-b] Hall p. 170, Umveka a. a. of a C. on Tantravārttika is obviously wrong.
--C. on Maṇḍana's Bhāvanāviveka. Princess of Wales Sar. Bha. Texts 6.
--C. Tātparyaṭīkā on Kumarila's Ślokavārttika. inc.
Ed.. Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 13.
Q. Bhartṛmitra, Bhartṛīśvara, Vākyapadīya, Dharmakīrti, Diṅnāga, Vṛttikāra, Vivaraṇa, Vindhyavāsin, Vyāli, the Sāmkhya writer Mādhava. He is q. also in Vādirāja's C. on Nyāyaviniścaya of Akalaṅka, Bhāratīya Jnānapīṭha edn., Banaras, Vol. I. p.. 31, l. 4. 175, l. 7; in Parameśvara's C. on Nītitattvāvirbhāva, Adyar ms., XXXIX. A. 8.
